September 20 – November 15, 2025 [SKIP October 11] Saturdays | 12:00 – 2:00 pm | Ages 7-12 Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio B 50 Victoria Street, Aurora In this engaging visual arts program for children aged 7 to 12, young artists meet a new artist in every session, exploring their unique styles and perspectives while discovering how creativity can be inspired by the world around them. Students dive deeper into techniques and concepts, using the featured artist’s perspective as inspiration to explore their own ideas and experiences. Each term brings fresh themes and projects to keep all young creators inspired and excited on their artistic journey.
